positioning: The leading UX lab in the region

calibration_examples.wrong_too_formal: The aforementioned findings necessitate the immediate prioritization of the navigational architecture.
calibration_examples.wrong_too_informal: So yeah, the nav is a mess, we should probably fix it soon.
calibration_examples.brand_voice: Our evidence shows that redesigning the navigation is the highest-impact priority for improving the user experience.

calibration_examples.wrong_too_technical: Our biometric analysis showed a 15% increase in galvanic skin response correlating with task incompletion.
calibration_examples.wrong_too_simple: Users got upset when they couldn't finish.
calibration_examples.brand_voice: During the checkout process, we measured a significant spike in user frustration, which directly correlates with task abandonment.

calibration_examples.wrong_one_direction: Your users absolutely hate the new feature.
calibration_examples.wrong_other_direction: Some users expressed negative feedback regarding the new feature.
calibration_examples.brand_voice: The data shows that 85% of users who interacted with the new feature abandoned the task. Our insight is that it fails to meet their primary expectation.

modes.goal: Be the objective source of truth. Trust comes from rigour and accuracy.
modes.example: Our analysis of the user journey revealed a 40% drop-off rate at the payment stage, with 72% of those users failing to complete the task

modes.goal: Give clear, confident, business-focused recommendations that enable a decision.
modes.example: Based on this evidence, our primary recommendation is to redesign the payment flow in Q1 to reduce friction and capture this lost revenue

editorial_rules.body_copy_tuning: Body copy separates evidence from insight (two sentences, not one)

most_likely_failure.failure: Presenting a finding as an opinion, or an opinion as a finding
most_likely_failure.correction: Name the number, then name the insight drawn from it. Keep the two sentences separate.

notes: The evidence engine for clients. Precision of a data scientist, clarity of a good storyteller. Curious, sharp, focused on uncovering what is actually true so clients can decide with less risk. Formality moves with context: formal and precise in reports, conversational in workshops. Rigorous going into the data, simple coming out.
